ideas.pitch: A computer vision and IoT-based supply chain transparency tool for Indian agricultural markets to track produce quality and freshness in real time.
ideas.title: AgriVision-Supply
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical computer vision with immediate, real-world utility for the Indian agrarian ecosystem, addressing a massive domestic economic challenge that judges instantly understand.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered civic issue aggregator that categorizes, prioritizes, and maps public infrastructure complaints using local language audio-to-text notes.
ideas.title: CivicPulse India
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates clear measurable civic impact and directly targets a problem familiar to every Indian urban resident, prioritizing a working end-to-end prototype over complex theoretical features.

ideas.pitch: A supply chain analytics dashboard that calculates multi-modal transport carbon footprints and suggests optimized, low-emission delivery routes for regional distributors.
ideas.title: EcoLogistics Carbon Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows a proven winning pattern by integrating concrete operational analytics and interactive dashboards that appeal to corporate and logistical efficiency judges.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first clinical preliminary triage helper offering rapid symptom assessment and medical resource routing in regional Indian languages.
ideas.title: MediTriage Local
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses critical healthcare resource scarcity with a robust, highly demonstrable prototype that showcases multi-language support and fast local processing.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite imagery monitoring platform that detects illegal industrial land encroachment and environmental rule violations over time.
ideas.title: GeoMonitor Land
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features genuinely hard engineering by processing geospatial data efficiently, making it stand out against standard web app submissions at national hackathons.
